author: Milner, Samuel
title: United States Army in World War II — The War in the Pacific: Victory in Papua
publisher: Office of the Chief of Military History, Department of the Army, Washington, D.C.
notes: Milne Bay, Buna and Gona — the other first offensive, running at the same time as Guadalcanal and usually left out of an American telling of it. Wanted precisely because a Pacific arc that goes Guadalcanal-to-Okinawa without Papua is a US Navy arc. First printed 1957, CMH Pub 5-4, LC 56-60001, read off the title page of the 1989 CMH facsimile. The Japanese side of the same fighting is source:bullard-2007, which is a translation of the Senshi Sōsho volumes that cover it. Same reachability note as source:morton-1962.
